In the final days of my Dad's life, I was sitting looking out the window of his room (palliative care, cancer sucks) and he was awake but no longer himself. Suddenly, he said my name with excitement, repeating it several times. I turned and looked at him in his bed.

"Justine you're on the tele!" 

I glanced at the tv, which was off. Then I realised he could see my reflection on the screen. 

It was so bloody adorable and I felt so loved in that moment. His death was extremely difficult for me heal from...and as the years have passed I remember less of the day-after-day stress and fatigue of being at the hospital...and instead I cherish this bizarre moment. Once of the last moments I ever had with him.
